Terms.title: Terms & Conditions for NÜVIA OÜ
Terms.intro: This document, along with our Privacy Policy and Cookie Policy, governs the use of all digital services, platforms, and travel arrangements offered by NÜVIA OÜ, in accordance with EU laws and GDPR compliance.

section1.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
section1.paragraph1: These Terms and Conditions ("Terms") govern your access to and use of all digital platforms, applications, and travel services provided by NÜVIA. By accessing or using any of our services, you agree to these Terms. If you do not agree, do not use our services.
section1.paragraph2: This contract is concluded electronically and becomes legally binding upon your use of our services, as per EU Regulation (EU) No 910/2014 on electronic identification and trust services (eIDAS).

section2.title: 2. Our Services
section2.intro: NÜVIA is a travel technology platform based in Estonia, operating under EU consumer protection and digital services laws. We assist users in planning, customizing, and booking travel services. Our offerings include:
section2.item1: AI-powered planning and trip generation based on user preferences.
section2.item2: Booking of travel services (flights, accommodations, insurance, transfers, excursions) provided by third parties.
section2.item3: Centralized access to travel documents and itinerary management.
section2.item4: Service aggregation and optional integration into Linked Travel Arrangements (LTAs).

section3.title: 3. Linked Travel Arrangements (LTA)
section3.intro: As per Directive (EU) 2015/2302, some bookings made on our platform may constitute Linked Travel Arrangements (LTA), which are not package holidays.
section3.characteristic1: You purchase at least two different travel services (e.g., hotel and flight) for the same trip.
section3.characteristic2: Services are booked under separate contracts.
section3.characteristic3: NÜVIA facilitates the booking of the second service within 24 hours via a targeted interface.
section3.protection1: Limited insolvency protection applies to the travel services directly booked through NÜVIA.
section3.protection2: You will be informed at checkout whether your combination constitutes an LTA.
section3.protection3: LTAs do not offer the same rights to modification, refunds, or assistance as package holidays.

section4.title: 4. User Eligibility
section4.paragraph1: You must be at least 18 years old and have legal capacity under applicable national laws to use our services.
section4.paragraph2: Under EU consumer law (Directive 2011/83/EU), minors may use the service only with the verifiable consent of a parent or legal guardian.

section5.title: 5. Account and Security
section5.item1: Providing accurate and complete registration data.
section5.paragraph: You are liable for all actions conducted under your account unless proven otherwise under applicable security provisions (e.g., GDPR Article 32).

section6.title: 6. Booking and Payment
section6.item1: Prices and availability are subject to change until your booking is confirmed.
section6.item2: Charges may include applicable VAT, duties, or surcharges under Council Directive 2006/112/EC.
section6.item3: Payments are processed via compliant third-party providers (e.g., Stripe, Adyen) and protected via SSL encryption.
section6.item4: In case of LTAs, each travel service is subject to the payment terms of its provider.
section6.item5: Currency conversion fees may apply depending on your bank or card issuer.

section7.title: 7. Cancellations and Modifications
section7.paragraph: Each service provider defines their own cancellation and refund policy. Under EU law (Directive 2011/83/EU), your right of withdrawal may not apply to time-specific travel services or to flights and hotels with individual terms. Review each individual terms before confirming your booking.

section8.title: 8. Travel Documents and Requirements
section8.paragraph1: You are solely responsible for ensuring that you meet entry and exit requirements for all countries you visit, including passports, visas, vaccination proofs, and insurance.
section8.paragraph2: NÜVIA is not responsible for denied boarding, visa refusals, or other administrative decisions by border or airline authorities. We may assist by offering relevant information platform-based services.

section11.paragraph2: Disputes, refunds, or performance claims must be directed to the relevant service provider in line with Regulation (EC) No 261/2004 (for flights) or applicable national contract laws.

section12.title: 12. Limitation of Liability
